title: Mixing: The Great Cock And Seagull Race by Paul McCartney | 1977
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Paul McCartney oversaw a mixing session for a Ram. album outtake on 26 November 1977.

The song, ‘Great Cock And Seagull Race’, had been recorded in 1971, but remained unreleased until the 2012 reissue of Ram.

McCartney’s reasons for reviving it on this day are unknown, although it is possible that he was considering it for inclusion on London Town or as a potential b-side. The stereo mixes were made under the working title ‘Blues (Longest Song Title In The World)’, ‘Blues’ being the song’s original name.
